Subject: Request: one-off download + bridge letter for VoltEdge audit window

Hi Mina,

Quick note from the Audits-Plus side: VoltEdge has a tight window to complete follow-up testing for the 2025 SOC 2 Type II. We only need a targeted subset of evidence — specifically:
- user activity logs (auth and session traces) for 2025-06 through 2025-10
- the retention policy snapshot that was in effect for that interval
- the change log for the SSO configuration (May–Oct 2025)

Rather than a full package, could Redwood provide a sliced zip (or presigned link) that contains those files? Ideally a short-lived link (48–72 hours) and a bridge letter confirming the audit period boundaries and that there were no control changes outside the provided change log that would affect the tested period.

Also — we may need a brief 30-minute walkthrough with someone from your security or platform team while we download to confirm file provenance. Do you have availability tomorrow or Monday?

Thanks,
Linda Foster
Senior Manager, Audit Delivery
Audits-Plus

Attachment: request_matrix.xlsx (reference; no upload needed yet)

Thanks for the clear list. We can do a sliced bundle and a short bridge letter. A couple of quick asks so we provision the exact package you need:
- Confirm the file names you expect for the activity logs (we keep them as daily compressed logs and can extract the date ranges you listed).
- Is a 48-hour presigned link sufficient, or do you prefer a 72-hour window? We typically limit downloads to 48 hours for external audit access but can make exceptions with a justification.
- For the walkthrough: I can host a 30-min session. My calendar is open tomorrow between 2–4pm PT and Monday 9–11am PT. Kimberly and Jordan are looped for the bridge-letter signoff and the log export respectively.

We will:
- Produce a zip containing only the requested slices (named evidence_slice_user_activity_logs_202506-202510.zip)
- Attach a brief bridge_letter_redwood_20261105.pdf that states the audit period and confirms the exported artifact scope
- Provide a presigned link (private) and an activity log of the export operation for your records

If that works I will initiate the export and share the link + calendar invite.

Best,
Mina Haddad

Redwood Inference
